name: AXM Secrets & Permissions Console
actions: store or rotate an encrypted connector secret
inspect declared module permissions separately from dependencies
record a reasoned expiry-aware permission decision
explicitly revoke a secret or permission
summary: Keep encrypted connector secrets write-only to the browser and manage deny-by-default grants for manifest permissions without turning module dependencies into authority.
notes: Secret values never return to the browser. Permission decisions require a declared manifest permission, reason, optional valid future expiry, explicit header and exact typed confirmation. Secret revocation has its own typed confirmation. Nothing grants automatically.
